# yasashii.org

> 行政手続き・防災情報の「やさしい日本語」版ライブラリ。国の一次情報（総務省・入管庁・内閣府・消防庁・e-Gov法令）に基づいてゼロから書き、人が検証した文書だけを verified と表示します。政府・役所のサイトではありません（運営: DroR Corporation、非営利・広告なし）。

Notation: 《…》= ふりがな (ruby) for the preceding kanji. Half-width spaces = 分かち書き word breaks.
If anything here differs from an official government page, the official page is correct.
License: CC BY 4.0 — attribution: yasashii.org (DroR Corporation)

## Machine-readable API (generated at build time from the same source as the HTML — never hand-synced)

- Documents (all, with tier / scores / verified sources): https://yasashii.org/api/documents.json
- Terms (役所のことばの やさしい説明): https://yasashii.org/api/terms.json
- Metadata: https://yasashii.org/api/meta.json
- Full text of every document: https://yasashii.org/llms-full.txt
- Every page as plain Markdown: append `index.md` to any page URL (e.g. https://yasashii.org/bunsho/tennyu-todoke/index.md)
- MCP server: `npx -y @dror-jp/yasashii-org-mcp`
